description: wildmat.rs wildmat_match() allocates a (pat_len+1) x (text_len+1) Vec<Vec<bool>> on every call. For the common case (GROUP command matching a group name against a filter of tens of patterns), this is called once per group per command. A single flat Vec<bool> with manual row indexing, or a stack-allocated array for short patterns, would avoid the inner Vec allocations.
title: core: wildmat DP uses Vec<Vec<bool>> allocation on every call
